mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 76 degrees at Verona Community Park under clear skies. Look to the sky early tomorrow morning for an ISS flyover appearing over Mount Horeb and heading toward Fitchburg, passing almost directly overhead. We are looking at an overnight low of 62 degrees with no rain expected.

The City of Verona has approved adjustments to sewer and stormwater utility rates to ensure self-supporting operations and prevent infrastructure failure. Additionally, the city has selected four student winners for the upcoming November 3 General Election I Voted sticker contest.
Today, Epic Systems is hosting their User Group Meeting. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing or Wisconsin Brewing Company, and the weekly Downtown Farmer's Market returns on Tuesday.
In a report from August 15, a 29-year-old Verona man was taken into custody for his second O W I and cited for failing to have an ignition interlock device.
Treat yourself to the Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor of the day at Culver's, and remember that Kona Ice will be at the Concerts at McKee until 9 PM tonight.
